gather.name: Miner
gather.text: Mines 2 crystals from a mine it stands next to (Fighters mine 1).

tunnel.name: Tunnel
tunnel.text: It can be summoned straight onto any empty space next to a mine your side owns right now.

frenzy.name: Frenzy
frenzy.text: +1 Attack when next to another Goblin.

ranged.name: Ranged
ranged.text: Hits the first unit up to 7 spaces away in a straight line (8 directions). Cannot shoot past a unit. No strike back.

kaboom.name: Ka-boom
kaboom.text: When defeated, deals 2 damage to all adjacent enemies.

sneaky.name: Sneaky
sneaky.text: Enemies cannot strike back at it.

haste.name: Haste
haste.text: Can act the turn it is played.

fixit.name: Fix-it
fixit.text: At the start of your turn, each adjacent ally gets Shield 1.

armored.name: Armored
armored.text: Rolls one extra block die (3 at most).

blink.name: Blink
blink.text: Once, swap places with any of your creatures.

overload.name: Overload
overload.text: Its attack also hits every enemy next to the target for 1.

guard.name: Guard
guard.text: Adjacent enemies must attack it first.

charge.name: Charge
charge.text: Can still attack after spending all its move points.

unbreakable.name: Unbreakable
unbreakable.text: Never takes more than 3 damage from one attack.

heartyale.name: Hearty Ale
heartyale.text: At the start of your turn, each adjacent ally gets +1 Health until your next turn.

eaterGuzzler.name: Crystal Eater
eaterGuzzler.text: Each extra Crystal card you play this turn deals 2 damage to it.

eaterConduit.name: Crystal Eater
eaterConduit.text: Each extra Crystal card you play this turn means it can't move or attack until your next turn, and it loses 1 Health.

eaterDelver.name: Crystal Eater
eaterDelver.text: Each extra Crystal card you play this turn gives it -1 Attack for the rest of the match.

smith.name: Smith
smith.text: Summon it as a Miner, or play it on one of your own creatures for a permanent +1 Attack or +1 Health.

kaboom1.name: Ka-boom 1
kaboom1.text: When defeated, deals 1 damage to every adjacent creature, friend or foe.

junkBoost.name: Junk Boost
junkBoost.text: On your turn, adjacent Goblins get +1 Attack.

siphon.name: Siphon
siphon.text: When it defeats a creature, your Bank gets +1 crystal.

glyphShield.name: Glyph Shield
glyphShield.text: At the start of your turn it gets Shield 1.

brew.name: Brew
brew.text: Once per turn, at any time (even on the enemy's turn): heal an adjacent wounded dwarf. If that dwarf would die, it survives with 1 Health instead. It becomes Drunk for 2 rounds. Drunk dwarves can't be healed.

riotShield.name: Riot Shield
riotShield.text: Enemies next to it must attack it first. It rolls one extra block die (3 at most), and nothing can knock it back, bowl it, lift it or shove it.

brood.name: Brood
brood.text: Deploy phase, 2 crystals, any number of times: a Piglet token appears next to her (max 4). Your Piglets have +1 Health.

poxDoctor.name: Pox Doctor
poxDoctor.text: Her hits Poison 3. Poisoned enemies have -1 Attack. Your poison ticks deal double.

drillSergeant.name: Drill Sergeant
drillSergeant.text: Piglets within 2 spaces get +1 Attack and can act the turn they appear.

fuseLighter.name: Fuse-Lighter
fuseLighter.text: Your Ka-booms deal +1. A friendly Goblin or Piglet defeated next to him Ka-booms for 1.

fling.name: Fling
fling.text: Pay 1, once per turn: throw an adjacent Piglet up to 5 spaces; it can attack this turn.

brewPoison.name: Bog Brew
brewPoison.text: Pay 1: an adjacent Goblin's hits Poison 2 this turn.

spark.name: Spark
spark.text: Deploy phase, 1 crystal, any number of times: a Spark Wisp token appears next to her (max 3). Wisps' spell discount is 2.

jinxmaster.name: Jinxmaster
jinxmaster.text: Enemies your spells damage become Jinxed. End of your turn: each Jinxed enemy within 4 spaces takes 1.

batteryCharge.name: Battery
batteryCharge.text: Each spell you cast this turn gives it +1 Attack this turn (max +3).

runeSpark.name: Rune Spark
runeSpark.text: Whenever you cast a spell: 1 damage to one Jinxed enemy in range.

lensGrinder.name: Lens Grinder
lensGrinder.text: Your Ranged allies within 2 spaces shoot 2 spaces further.

jinxHit.name: Jinx
jinxHit.text: Its hits Jinx the target: -1 Attack and +1 damage from spells until its owner's next turn.

ratchet.name: Ratchet
ratchet.text: +1 Attack while next to an Automaton.

build.name: Build
build.text: Deploy phase, 2 crystals, once per turn: a Clockwork Mule token appears next to him (max 3). Mules next to him mine +1.

forgemaster.name: Forgemaster
forgemaster.text: Upgrading a Dwarf also gives each Dwarf next to it +1 Health. Dwarves with a Smith upgrade are Armored.

shieldwall.name: Shield Wall
shieldwall.text: Walls within 2 spaces get +1 Attack and walk 3.

masterSmith.name: Master Smith
masterSmith.text: Your Smith upgrades give +2 Attack. Pay 2, once per turn: upgrade an adjacent Dwarf without a card.

drummer.name: Drummer
drummer.text: Dwarves next to him walk 1 further.

wrangler.name: Wrangler
wrangler.text: Clockwork Mules within 2 spaces mine +1 and can't be knocked back.

eager.name: Eager
eager.text: The first time it is upgraded it gets +1 Attack extra.
